reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass. Gate 1: `completeRegistration` is actively called at `src/app/register/[token]/page-client.tsx:27` (exported server action, non-test caller exists). Gate 2: entry point is Discord OAuth — an external, attacker-controlled data source (not TRUSTED/SEMI_TRUSTED). Gate 3: `src/app/actions.ts` and `src/app/register/` are explicitly in scope, and 'Discord membership verification bypass' is a listed key security concern. An attacker can trigger this via Discord OAuth login by authenticating as a former club member whose `supabase_auth_user_id` persists in `member.members`, then visiting the kiosk to scan a card and calling `completeRegistration`, causing card registration to succeed with no live guild membership or generation role check (the `is_in_server` check at `auth/callback/route.ts:L105-119` is commented out). No `deployment_context.client_diversity` cap present; original HIGH severity is maintained.
